layers.text: Recolour only: the dark grey boulder becomes a lighter mid slate grey rock, colour #8c929c, shaded #686e78, keeping its white snow and blue ice crust; the warm light grey snow of the body becomes a cool very light grey, colour #e2e5e8, shaded #c0c5cb.
